description: List a student's school days (instructional calendar) grouped by term. Returns one entry per enrollment, with term boundaries (Q1-Q4 start/end dates) and the school days inside each term — a day carries comments when the calendar labels it (e.g. 'Early Release Day'). Each enrollment also lists its labelled daysOff (e.g. 'Holiday', 'Teacher Work Day', 'Spring Break'), including breaks that fall between terms. Use since/until to narrow the range. An enrollment whose day list the district won't serve comes back with warning 'SchoolDaysUnavailable' (plus campusVersion when known), its terms and days off, and no school days.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD; include only days on or after this date

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD; include only days on or before this date

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns Infinite Campus's payload untouched. No field projection: this server has no verified record of which Infinite Campus fields matter, and inventing one would risk dropping a field a caller needs.

name: ic_list_school_days
